title: CodeX - Cloud IDE
description: Built a cloud-based IDE similar to Replit where users can write, edit, and run code directly in the browser.
Integrated Monaco Editor to provide a VS Code-like coding experience with syntax highlighting and multi-language support.
Implemented code execution using Piston API, allowing users to run code securely in multiple languages.
Built a file management system using Supabase where users can create, edit, and manage project files.
Developed an AI code assistant that helps users debug code, suggest improvements, and understand code using file context.
Added AI-based code suggestions and autocomplete that adapts based on the current code.
Built a code converter feature that translates code between different programming languages while keeping functionality intact.
Implemented rate limiting using Redis and MongoDB to control API usage and prevent abuse.
Used Redis for caching to improve performance and reduce repeated API calls.
Handled both frontend and backend using Next.js API routes and managed state using Zustand.
Focused on building a smooth and responsive UI using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn components.

title: PostMyGig - Freelance Gig Sharing Platform
description: Built a platform where freelancers can post extra work they can’t handle and other freelancers can discover and take those gigs.
Designed the full flow where a freelancer posts a gig, other users browse and apply, and the owner can shortlist and connect with them.
Built a real-time chat system using WebSockets (Socket.IO) with a separate Node.js backend, allowing freelancers to communicate instantly.
Handled chat events, connections, and messaging flow between users in real time.
Built a Community and Activity feature to show platform activity like users posting gigs, hiring, and interacting, helping build trust and engagement.
Implemented email notifications using Resend for user actions like applications and interactions.
Developed both frontend and backend using Next.js and Node.js, and designed database structure using MongoDB.
Used Redis to improve performance and speed up frequently accessed data.
Worked across the full stack to connect gig posting, real-time chat, activity tracking, and notifications into a single platform.

title: Quillo - Content Creation for Builders
description: Built a platform that helps builders turn their daily work updates into social media posts without starting from a blank page.
Designed a project-based workflow where users organize their work into projects and log daily progress before generating content.
Developed support for generating posts for X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and blogs with customizable tone, perspective, and content length.
Implemented Preference Memory using Gemini embeddings and MongoDB Atlas Vector Search to retrieve semantically similar approved posts and keep future content aligned with each user's writing style.
Built a context retrieval pipeline that combines project details, daily updates, previous posts, and writing preferences to generate more relevant content.
Added support for managing projects, tracking daily updates, saving drafts, and scheduling posts from a single dashboard.
Integrated Gemini with structured outputs and custom prompt engineering to generate consistent content based on the user's actual work instead of generic prompts.
Built a responsive interface using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI with server actions and a scalable backend architecture.

title: BuildMyCV - Automated Resume Builder
description: Built BuildMyCV as a personal project, which was later acquired and extended in collaboration with the owner of Dignify A Girl.
Initially developed core features including AI resume builder, job description analysis, and an AI assistant to help users improve their resumes.
Built a resume builder where users can generate and edit resumes using AI in an interactive interface.
Implemented a feature where users can upload their resume along with a job description, and the system analyzes how well the resume matches the job.
Built an AI assistant that answers questions based on the user’s resume and suggests improvements.
After the project was taken forward, worked on adding more features like job recommendations based on user profiles.
Integrated Stripe payments to support subscription-based access and premium features.
Worked on AI flows using LangChain and Gemini AI to generate structured outputs for resumes and analysis.
Used Firebase for storing user data and resume-related information and handled both frontend and backend using Next.js and Node.js.
Worked across the full stack to connect AI features, payments, and user workflows into a complete product.

title: Interview Buddy - Interactive Interview Prep
description: Built an AI-powered interview preparation platform where users can practice different types of interview questions based on role and difficulty.
Developed a system where users can generate role-specific questions (e.g., frontend, backend, system design) with adjustable difficulty levels.
Built support for multiple interview types including technical, behavioral, and HR rounds.
Implemented AI-generated answers with structured explanations to help users understand concepts clearly.
Added support for multiple programming languages, allowing users to practice language-specific questions.
Designed the UI to provide a smooth flow between different interview rounds and questions.
Worked on AI flows using LangChain and Gemini AI to generate relevant questions and detailed responses.
Focused on building a clean and interactive interface using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn components.
